name: Chobble Tickets
description: Event ticketing with QR check-in and encrypted attendee records. The complete product is AGPL-3.0 with no open core and no branding requirement, and it runs as an edge script without an always-on server (alternative to Eventbrite). ([Demo](https://tickets.crumpsallfolkclub.co.uk), [Source Code](https://github.com/chobbledotcom/tickets)) `AGPL-3.0` `Deno/Docker`
